title: O Lord, Do Not Delay

questions.question: Make haste, O God, to deliver me! O Lord, make haste to do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:1 (ESV): "Make haste, O God, to deliver me! O Lord, make haste to help me!"

questions.question: Let them be put to shame and confusion who seek my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:2 (ESV): "Let them be put to shame and confusion who seek my life!"

questions.question: Let them be turned back and brought to dishonor who desire my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:2 (ESV): "Let them be turned back and brought to dishonor who desire my hurt!"

questions.question: Let them turn back because of their shame who say, "What!"
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:3 (ESV): "Let them turn back because of their shame who say, 'Aha, Aha!'"

questions.question: May all who seek you rejoice and be glad in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:4 (ESV): "May all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you!"

questions.question: May those who love your salvation say evermore, "God is what!"
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:4 (ESV): "May those who love your salvation say evermore, 'God is great!'"

questions.question: But I am poor and needy; hasten to me, O what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:5 (ESV): "But I am poor and needy; hasten to me, O God!"

questions.question: You are my help and my deliverer; O Lord, do not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:5 (ESV): "You are my help and my deliverer; O Lord, do not delay!"

questions.question: This Psalm is nearly identical to the end of which other Psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70 is nearly identical to Psalm 40:13-17.

questions.question: What is the purpose of this Psalm according to the title?
Who is the author of Psalm 70?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70 Title: "To the choirmaster. Of David..."

questions.question: Who seeks the psalmist's life?
questions.explanation: The text refers to "them" who seek his life, without specific names in the psalm itself.

questions.question: Those who say "Aha, Aha!" should turn back because of their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:3 (ESV): "Let them turn back because of their shame..."

questions.question: The psalmist asks God to make haste to do what two things in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:1 (ESV): "Make haste, O God, to deliver me! O Lord, make haste to help me!"

questions.question: What defines those who say "God is great"?
questions.explanation: Psalm 70:4 (ESV): "...May those who love your salvation say evermore, 'God is great!'"

key_verse_text: But I am poor and needy; hasten to me, O God! You are my help and my deliverer; O Lord, do not delay!
